system.flavor:
Hold a door shut against someone pushing from the other side, anchor a rope while a friend climbs, stand in a river crossing where others would be swept away, keep your feet when a crowd pushes past, or brace a ladder for a climber.

Not enough to hold back a cart on a slope or anchor a boat in a current.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Reduce the next incoming Damage by 1 and resist up to 2 units of forced movement until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: Suppress one Light physical Wound Condition's Movement penalty until the start of your next turn.
An adjacent willing ally may share the forced-movement protection.

rider.title: Adaptation - Titan
rider.html: Assume Rooted Mass (upkeep 0): while stationary, adjacent willing allies resist the first 1 unit of forced movement against them each round. You count as an ally for this benefit.
